results.title: Little Feat: The Documentary
results.overview: Narrated by Jeff Bridges, Little Feat: The Documentary tells the untold story of one of America’s most influential and under-appreciated bands, featuring never-before-seen footage and stories from iconic fans and friends, including Bonnie Raitt, Linda Ronstadt, Jackson Browne, Elvis Costello, members of the Doobie Brothers, Phish and the Grateful Dead.

results.title: Io sono Felice
results.overview: Felice Andreasi, from the Derby Club to painting: the story of a one-of-a-kind talent, unconcerned with fame and devoted solely to his art.

results.title: Focal Length
results.overview: Ada, a legal investigator, is assigned to surveil a politician and expose a political conspiracy. As the stakes rise, she must confront a difficult question: will she uncover the truth, or will her own methods and troubled past catch up with her first?

results.title: El patio
results.overview: During naptime at their grandfather's house, Julia and Matías play in the yard until Julia throws the ball into the neighboring property—owned by Ranamacho, a mysterious man who destroys any balls that land on his land. Caught between naivety and fear, the siblings' relationship becomes strained when Matías attempts to climb the wall to retrieve it.

results.title: Chellamada Nee Enakku
results.overview: Chellamada Nee Enakku is a Tamil movie starring Vashi Karan, Neha Sri and Boss Venkat in prominent roles. It is directed by Anand Shivam

results.title: Marvin Gaye - Visionär des Soul
results.overview: He was the gentle rebel of soul: Marvin Gaye, one of the greatest musicians of the 20th century. With his unmistakable voice and hits, he left an indelible mark on American pop culture—one that endures to this day.

results.title: Spectacular by Comparison
results.overview: In Park City, Utah a group of independent filmmakers attend a shoestring film festival and experience the oft-regular disillusionment of the low budget film world. However, they enter the orbit of the one man running the show and decide to come back the following year to help and change what was a beautiful disaster the year before.

results.title: Go On
results.overview: Two strangers on a remote mountain, scorched by forest fires, help each other process baggage from their previous lives so they can transition to the afterlife.

results.title: The Honest Realtor
results.overview: An elite real estate agent who lost the ability to lie due to a curse must navigate the cutthroat industry using only the honest truth.

results.title: The Genesis Project
results.overview: For their term project, five psychology students decide to study serial killers to learn what turns a normal person, into a cold-blooded murderer. With the knowledge they gain, they attempt to capture the killer stalking their town.

results.title: El espacio entre lo rojo
results.overview: What inhabits the space between two people saying goodbye, between the last glance and the closing door? A couple faces their final encounter, suspended in that uncertain time between memory and oblivion.

results.title: La fête de la chanson française - 20 ans d'émotions

results.title: The Jesus Tapes
results.overview: Jesus returns to a disturbed, distracted world and is interviewed on a public access TV show.

results.title: Dementium
results.overview: Wyatt Bailey retreats to a secluded cabin to solve his mother’s murder. After taking DMT to confront his dead father, he’s torn between visions of his ex-girlfriend offering hope and a witch urging destruction in a battle for his soul.

results.title: DIA
results.overview: DIA follows a reclusive young woman whose encounter with a gentle butcher at a wet market triggers fear, vulnerability, and paranoia. As reality blurs with anxiety, she must confront the walls she has built around herself and find the courage to let someone in.

results.title: Flat Earth
results.overview: After years of obsessive research, a brilliant but isolated physicist succeeds in creating the world's first artificial black hole inside a secret laboratory. Instead of unlocking the secrets of gravity, the experiment tears open reality itself, revealing an impossible truth: the world is not a globe, but one of countless vast, layered planes stacked beyond human perception.
